name: Alpaca
tagline: A paper-only desk for rehearsing options and equity decisions
description: Built on the Alpaca API for simulated trading, so nothing here touches a funded account. It steps through position sizing gradually, runs at the open, midday and close on a schedule, and keeps its cut-out switches in place throughout. Prove the process on paper before going anywhere near real money.
author: swartzendruber
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
